```{r setup}
library(jsonlite)
library(knitr)

payload <- jsonlite::fromJSON(params$payload_json, simplifyVector = FALSE)

esc_html <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0L || is.na(x)) return("")
  s <- as.character(x)
  s <- gsub("&", "&amp;", s, fixed = TRUE)
  s <- gsub("<", "&lt;", s, fixed = TRUE)
  s <- gsub(">", "&gt;", s, fixed = TRUE)
  s <- gsub('"', "&quot;", s, fixed = TRUE)
  s
}

render_edatopic_svg <- function(grid_obj, title_text, is_actual = FALSE) {
  snrs <- c("A", "B", "C", "D", "E")
  rows <- if (is_actual) {
    c("0", "0.5", "1", "1.5", "2", "2.5", "3", "3.5", "4", "4.5", "5", "5.5", "6", "6.5", "7", "7.5", "8")
  } else {
    c("0", "1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6", "7", "8")
  }
  cell_w <- 46
  cell_h <- if (is_actual) 18 else 30
  pad_l <- 52
  pad_t <- 44
  w <- pad_l + length(snrs) * cell_w + 18
  h <- pad_t + length(rows) * cell_h + 24

  cells_list <- if (!is.null(grid_obj) && !is.null(grid_obj$cells)) grid_obj$cells else list()
  max_cnt <- 1L
  cell_map <- new.env(hash = TRUE, parent = emptyenv())
  for (c_item in cells_list) {
    key <- paste0(as.character(c_item$moisture), "|", toupper(as.character(c_item$nutrient)))
    cnt <- as.integer(c_item$count)
    if (cnt > max_cnt) max_cnt <- cnt
    assign(key, c_item, envir = cell_map)
  }

  parts <- c(
    sprintf('<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 %d %d" width="%d" height="%d" role="img" aria-label="%s">', w, h, w, h, esc_html(title_text)),
    sprintf('<rect x="0" y="0" width="%d" height="%d" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#cbd5e1" rx="4"/>', w, h),
    sprintf('<text x="%d" y="18" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#003366">%s</text>', as.integer(w / 2), esc_html(title_text))
  )

  for (ci in seq_along(snrs)) {
    cx <- pad_l + (ci - 1L) * cell_w + (cell_w / 2)
    parts <- c(parts, sprintf('<text x="%.1f" y="36" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#1e293b">%s</text>', cx, snrs[[ci]]))
  }

  for (ri in seq_along(rows)) {
    ry <- pad_t + (ri - 1L) * cell_h
    r_lbl <- rows[[ri]]
    parts <- c(parts, sprintf('<text x="%d" y="%.1f" text-anchor="end" font-family="monospace" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#334155">%s</text>', pad_l - 6, ry + (cell_h * 0.68), r_lbl))
    for (ci in seq_along(snrs)) {
      cx <- pad_l + (ci - 1L) * cell_w
      key <- paste0(r_lbl, "|", snrs[[ci]])
      cnt <- 0L
      if (exists(key, envir = cell_map, inherits = FALSE)) {
        cnt <- as.integer(get(key, envir = cell_map)$count)
      }
      fill <- "#f8fafc"
      txt_col <- "#64748b"
      if (cnt > 0L) {
        ratio <- cnt / max_cnt
        if (ratio >= 0.75) {
          fill <- "#003366"
          txt_col <- "#ffffff"
        } else if (ratio >= 0.40) {
          fill <- "#2563eb"
          txt_col <- "#ffffff"
        } else {
          fill <- "#bfdbfe"
          txt_col <- "#0f172a"
        }
      }
      parts <- c(parts, sprintf('<rect x="%d" y="%d" width="%d" height="%d" fill="%s" stroke="#94a3b8" stroke-width="0.8"/>', cx, ry, cell_w, cell_h, fill))
      if (cnt > 0L) {
        parts <- c(parts, sprintf('<text x="%.1f" y="%.1f" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="%s">%d</text>', cx + (cell_w / 2), ry + (cell_h * 0.68), txt_col, cnt))
      }
    }
  }
  parts <- c(parts, "</svg>")
  paste(parts, collapse = "\n")
}

render_aspect_rose_svg <- function(sectors_list) {
  labels <- c("N", "NE", "E", "SE", "S", "SW", "W", "NW")
  counts <- integer(8L)
  if (!is.null(sectors_list)) {
    for (s_item in sectors_list) {
      idx <- match(toupper(as.character(s_item$sector)), labels)
      if (!is.na(idx)) counts[[idx]] <- as.integer(s_item$count)
    }
  }
  max_c <- max(1L, counts)
  cx <- 120
  cy <- 125
  r_max <- 78

  parts <- c(
    '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 245" width="240" height="245" role="img" aria-label="Aspect Rose Diagram">',
    '<rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="245" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#cbd5e1" rx="4"/>',
    '<text x="120" y="18" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#003366">Aspect Rose (8-Sector)</text>',
    sprintf('<circle cx="%d" cy="%d" r="%.1f" fill="none" stroke="#e2e8f0" stroke-dasharray="3,3"/>', cx, cy, r_max * 0.5),
    sprintf('<circle cx="%d" cy="%d" r="%d" fill="none" stroke="#cbd5e1"/>', cx, cy, r_max),
    sprintf('<line x1="%d" y1="%d" x2="%d" y2="%d" stroke="#e2e8f0"/>', cx - r_max, cy, cx + r_max, cy),
    sprintf('<line x1="%d" y1="%d" x2="%d" y2="%d" stroke="#e2e8f0"/>', cx, cy - r_max, cx, cy + r_max)
  )

  for (i in seq_len(8L)) {
    ang_deg <- (i - 1L) * 45.0 - 90.0
    a1 <- (ang_deg - 18.0) * pi / 180.0
    a2 <- (ang_deg + 18.0) * pi / 180.0
    rad <- if (counts[[i]] > 0L) max(10.0, (counts[[i]] / max_c) * r_max) else 0.0
    if (rad > 0.0) {
      x1 <- cx + rad * cos(a1)
      y1 <- cy + rad * sin(a1)
      x2 <- cx + rad * cos(a2)
      y2 <- cy + rad * sin(a2)
      parts <- c(parts, sprintf(
        '<path d="M %d %d L %.1f %.1f A %.1f %.1f 0 0 1 %.1f %.1f Z" fill="#003366" fill-opacity="0.82" stroke="#FCBA19" stroke-width="1.2"/>',
        cx, cy, x1, y1, rad, rad, x2, y2
      ))
    }
    am <- ang_deg * pi / 180.0
    lx <- cx + (r_max + 15.0) * cos(am)
    ly <- cy + (r_max + 15.0) * sin(am) + 4.0
    parts <- c(parts, sprintf('<text x="%.1f" y="%.1f" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#1e293b">%s (%d)</text>', lx, ly, labels[[i]], counts[[i]]))
  }
  parts <- c(parts, "</svg>")
  paste(parts, collapse = "\n")
}

render_boxplot_svg <- function(box_obj, title_text, unit_suffix) {
  parts <- c(
    '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 280 115" width="280" height="115" role="img">',
    '<rect x="0" y="0" width="280" height="115" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#cbd5e1" rx="4"/>',
    sprintf('<text x="140" y="18" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#003366">%s</text>', esc_html(title_text))
  )
  if (is.null(box_obj) || is.null(box_obj$n) || as.integer(box_obj$n) == 0L) {
    parts <- c(parts, '<text x="140" y="64" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="11" fill="#64748b">No measured values in scope</text></svg>')
    return(paste(parts, collapse = "\n"))
  }
  mn <- as.numeric(box_obj$min)
  q1 <- as.numeric(box_obj$q1)
  md <- as.numeric(box_obj$median)
  q3 <- as.numeric(box_obj$q3)
  mx <- as.numeric(box_obj$max)
  span <- max(1e-6, mx - mn)
  scale_x <- function(v) 28.0 + ((v - mn) / span) * 224.0

  x_mn <- scale_x(mn)
  x_q1 <- scale_x(q1)
  x_md <- scale_x(md)
  x_q3 <- scale_x(q3)
  x_mx <- scale_x(mx)

  parts <- c(parts,
    sprintf('<line x1="%.1f" y1="56" x2="%.1f" y2="56" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="2"/>', x_mn, x_mx),
    sprintf('<line x1="%.1f" y1="42" x2="%.1f" y2="70" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="2"/>', x_mn, x_mn),
    sprintf('<line x1="%.1f" y1="42" x2="%.1f" y2="70" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="2"/>', x_mx, x_mx),
    sprintf('<rect x="%.1f" y="38" width="%.1f" height="36" fill="#dbeafe" stroke="#003366" stroke-width="2"/>', x_q1, max(3.0, x_q3 - x_q1)),
    sprintf('<line x1="%.1f" y1="36" x2="%.1f" y2="76" stroke="#FCBA19" stroke-width="3"/>', x_md, x_md),
    sprintf('<text x="140" y="98" text-anchor="middle" font-family="monospace" font-size="10" fill="#1e293b">n=%d | Min %.1f%s | Med %.1f%s | Max %.1f%s</text>',
            as.integer(box_obj$n), mn, unit_suffix, md, unit_suffix, mx, unit_suffix),
    '</svg>'
  )
  paste(parts, collapse = "\n")
}
```

```{r render_body, results='asis'}
cat(sprintf(
  '<div class="bcgov-banner"><h1>%s</h1><div class="subtitle">B.C. Ministry of Forests — Biogeoclimatic Ecosystem Classification (BEC) Program | Project: %s | Plots: %d | Generated: %s</div></div>',
  esc_html(payload$title),
  esc_html(payload$project),
  as.integer(payload$plotCount),
  esc_html(payload$generatedAt)
))

cat('<div class="guide-container">')

# Concept Section
cat('<div class="card"><h2>Ecological Concept & Site Diagnosis</h2>')
cat(sprintf('<p>%s</p>', gsub("\n", "<br/>", esc_html(payload$conceptNotes))))
cat('<div class="kpi-strip">')
cat(sprintf('<div class="kpi-box"><div class="kpi-label">Target Unit</div><div class="kpi-val">%s</div></div>', esc_html(payload$targetUnit)))
cat(sprintf('<div class="kpi-box"><div class="kpi-label">BGC Subzone</div><div class="kpi-val">%s</div></div>', esc_html(payload$bgcLabel)))
cat(sprintf('<div class="kpi-box"><div class="kpi-label">Sampled Plots</div><div class="kpi-val">%d</div></div>', as.integer(payload$plotCount)))
if (!is.null(payload$climateSummary)) {
  cs <- payload$climateSummary
  cat(sprintf('<div class="kpi-box"><div class="kpi-label">MAT / MAP</div><div class="kpi-val">%.1f C / %.0f mm</div></div>', as.numeric(cs$meanMat), as.numeric(cs$meanMap)))
  cat(sprintf('<div class="kpi-box"><div class="kpi-label">MSP / PAS</div><div class="kpi-val">%.0f / %.0f mm</div></div>', as.numeric(cs$meanMsp), as.numeric(cs$meanPas)))
  cat(sprintf('<div class="kpi-box"><div class="kpi-label">Mean CMD</div><div class="kpi-val">%.0f mm</div></div>', as.numeric(cs$meanCmd)))
}
cat('</div></div>')

# Dual Edatopic Grids + Topographic Diagrams
cat('<div class="card"><h2>Dual Edatopic Grids (Relative rSMR vs Actual aSMR) & Topographic Position</h2><div class="grid-row">')
cat(render_edatopic_svg(payload$relativeGrid, "Relative Edatopic Grid (rSMR x rSNR)", FALSE))
cat(render_edatopic_svg(payload$actualGrid, "Actual Edatopic Grid (aSMR x rSNR)", TRUE))
cat(render_aspect_rose_svg(payload$aspectRose))
cat('<div>')
cat(render_boxplot_svg(payload$elevationStats, "Elevation Distribution", " m"))
cat('<div style="height:10px"></div>')
cat(render_boxplot_svg(payload$slopeStats, "Slope Gradient Distribution", "%"))
cat('</div></div></div>')

# Vegetation Summary Table
cat('<div class="card"><h2>Characteristic Vegetation Summary</h2>')
veg_rows <- if (!is.null(payload$vegetationTable)) payload$vegetationTable else list()
if (length(veg_rows) == 0L) {
  cat('<p>No vegetation records met the summary threshold.</p>')
} else {
  cat('<table class="bec-table"><thead><tr><th>Stratum</th><th>Code</th><th>Scientific Name</th><th>Common Name</th><th>Constancy (%)</th><th>Class</th><th>Mean Cover (%)</th></tr></thead><tbody>')
  for (vr in veg_rows) {
    cat(sprintf(
      '<tr><td>%s</td><td><code>%s</code></td><td class="sci-name">%s</td><td>%s</td><td>%.1f</td><td>%s</td><td>%.2f</td></tr>',
      esc_html(vr$layer),
      esc_html(vr$species),
      esc_html(vr$scientificName),
      esc_html(vr$englishName),
      as.numeric(vr$constancyPct),
      esc_html(vr$constancyClass),
      as.numeric(vr$meanCover)
    ))
  }
  cat('</tbody></table>')
}
cat('</div></div>')
```
